dpRow.region: DP table, scrolls sideways when wider than the screen
dpRow.legendRead: Dashed border: a cell it reads
dpRow.legendHouses: Above: the value of each house, v[i - 1] above best[i].
dpRow.legendInf: INF = amount + 1, more than any answer: the amount is not made yet.

stairs.start: ways[i] is the number of ways to reach step i. Base cases: ways[0] = ways[1] = 1.
stairs.step: The last move to step {{i}} was 1 step, from {{a}}, or 2 steps, from {{b}}: {{formula}}.
stairs.hint: A whole number from 1 to {{max}}, so the row fits. (The problem allows n up to 90.)

house.start: best[i] is the largest total using only the first i houses. Base cases: best[0] = 0 and best[1] = {{first}}, the first house.
house.take: House {{i}} ({{v}}): skip it, {{skip}}, or take it, {{take}}. Taking it is larger: {{result}}.
house.skip: House {{i}} ({{v}}): skip it, {{skip}}, or take it, {{take}}. Skipping it is larger: {{result}}.
house.tie: House {{i}} ({{v}}): skip it, {{skip}}, or take it, {{take}}. Both are equal: {{result}}.
house.hint: 1 to {{max}} whole numbers from 0 to 99, separated by spaces or commas. (The problem allows up to 1000 houses.)
house.invalid: Use whole numbers from 0 to 99, separated by spaces or commas.

coins.start: best[x] is the fewest coins making amount x. best[0] = 0; every other amount starts at INF = {{inf}} (amount + 1), more than any answer.
coins.better: Amount {{x}}, coin {{c}}: {{expr}}, smaller than the best so far, {{old}}: {{result}}.
coins.notBetter: Amount {{x}}, coin {{c}}: {{expr}}, not smaller than the best so far, {{old}}: best[{{x}}] stays {{old}}.
coins.fromInf: Amount {{x}}, coin {{c}}: best[{{r}}] is INF, so amount {{r}} cannot be made and this coin cannot finish {{x}}: best[{{x}}] stays {{old}}.
coins.noCoin: Amount {{x}}: no coin is at most {{x}}, so best[{{x}}] stays INF.
coins.none: best[{{x}}] is still INF: amount {{x}} cannot be made. Print -1.
coins.hint: 1 to {{maxCoins}} different coin values from 1 to {{maxValue}}, and an amount from 0 to {{maxAmount}}, so the row fits. (The problem allows amounts up to 10000.)
coins.coinsInvalid: Use 1 to {{maxCoins}} different whole numbers from 1 to {{maxValue}}, separated by spaces or commas.
coins.amountInvalid: The amount must be a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.
